lines.title: Southworth Backsaver Hydraulic Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Southworth's standard Backsaver scissor lift tables, rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb with raised heights up to 55 in.
lines.content:
Backsaver Hydraulic Lift Tables are Southworth's general-purpose scissor lifts for machine feeding, work positioning, assembly, order picking and pallet loading. Low-pressure hydraulics give fast raising and lowering, and the down speed is fully adjustable.

Models are rated from 2,000 to 6,000 lb with 24, 36 or 48 in. of travel, in standard and wide-base (W) versions with platforms up to 72 x 96 in. Heavy-duty torque tubes, full-width straight-through axles and wire-braided hoses add stability, and pins, rollers and bushings are lubricated for life. Air or electric power units and a range of controls and tops are available.
key_features: 24, 36 and 48 in. travel; standard and wide-base models
Heavy-duty torque tubes and straight-through axles
Safety maintenance props and pressure relief valve
Pins, rollers and bushings lubricated for life

lines.title: Southworth Backsaver Lite Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Light-duty Backsaver scissor lift tables rated 550 to 1,500 lb, running on 115V power.
lines.content:
The Backsaver Lite is a cost-effective light-duty scissor lift for removing manual lifting from smaller jobs. It shares the low-pressure hydraulics, adjustable down speed and lubricated-for-life pivots of the full Backsaver range.

Models are rated at 550, 1,100 and 1,500 lb, on 20 x 36 in. or 24 x 48 in. platforms, and raise to as much as 41-1/4 in. They run on standard 115V single-phase power, and include a transparent return line to guard against spills and built-in maintenance chocks.

lines.title: Southworth Backsaver Lite Portable Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Battery-powered mobile Backsaver Lite tables rated 550 and 1,100 lb.
lines.content:
Backsaver Lite Portable Lift Tables put the light-duty Backsaver on four easy-rolling locking casters with an internal 12V DC power unit and built-in charger, so a powered lift can be rolled to wherever it is needed.

Both models raise to 36-1/2 in. from a 10-1/2 in. lowered height and carry 550 or 1,100 lb on a 24 x 40 in. platform, with larger platforms to 30 x 48 in. Push-button pendant controls raise and lower the load, and the bolt-on power unit gives easy access for service.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Backsaver Compact Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Double-scissor compact tables that lift 36 in. from a 12 x 24 in. footprint, rated 500 and 1,000 lb.
lines.content:
Backsaver Compact Lift Tables use a double scissor mechanism to give a full 36 in. of lift from a footprint as small as 12 x 24 in., for light loads in tight spaces.

They are rated at 500 or 1,000 lb, with platforms from 12 x 24 in. up to 24 x 36 in., and run on 115V single-phase power. Southworth offers them stationary, as a high-lift compact, on casters, and as a powered portable with a battery drive.
key_features: 12 x 24 in. standard platform; up to 24 x 36 in.
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth LS-Series Hydraulic Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Rugged industrial scissor lifts rated up to 12,000 lb with raised heights up to 98 in.
lines.content:
LS-Series Hydraulic Lift Tables are Southworth's heavier industrial scissor lifts for machine feeding, work positioning, assembly, order picking and pallet loading. Standard models are available for quick shipment.

Models in this range are rated from 2,000 to 12,000 lb, with raised heights up to 98 in. and platforms up to 60 x 156 in. They can be fitted with conveyor, ball transfer or turntable tops, a choice of power and controls, and finishes including two-part epoxy, corrosion-resistant coatings and stainless steel.
key_features: Conveyor, ball transfer and turntable tops
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth LSD-Series Dual Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Side-by-side dual scissor lifts for wide loads, rated 4,000 to 12,000 lb on platforms up to 11 ft wide.
lines.content:
LSD-Series lift tables place two sets of legs and lift cylinders side by side under one platform. The dual mechanism carries high capacities and keeps lifting smooth even when the load is off center.

Models are rated from 4,000 to 12,000 lb with raised heights up to 70 in. Standard LSD tables take platforms up to 8 ft wide, and LSD Wide Base tables up to 11 ft wide.
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth LST-Series Tandem Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Tandem scissor lifts for long loads such as lumber, pipe and sheet, rated 4,000 to 12,000 lb.
lines.content:
LST Tandem Lift Tables give a level rise for long loads such as lumber, pipe, sheet, bar stock and assemblies. They are often used to feed tube welders, formers and panel saws, and for bundling and banding long material.

The tandem design combines high capacity with a low lowered height. Models are rated from 4,000 to 12,000 lb with raised heights up to 70 in., in standard and wide versions with platforms up to 17 ft long.
key_features: Tandem scissor design for long loads
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth L-Series Cam Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: High-capacity cam-action scissor lifts rated 8,000 to 30,000 lb with low lowered heights.
lines.content:
L-Series Cam Lift Tables use a cam design that allows very high capacities while keeping the lowered height low. They are also the base for Southworth's L-Series coil cars.

Models are rated from 8,000 to 30,000 lb, with raised heights up to 47 in. and platforms up to 72 x 96 in.
key_features: Cam design for high capacity at low height
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Heavy-Duty Hydraulic Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Heavy-plate scissor lifts with overload relief, rated up to 25,000 lb with raised heights up to 100 in.
lines.content:
Southworth Heavy-Duty Hydraulic Lift Tables are built for heavy loads in demanding industrial settings. Heavy-plate platforms with structural reinforcement keep deflection low, a wide base adds rigidity, and a built-in hydraulic overload relief protects people and structures.

They handle loads up to 25,000 lb, raise as high as 100 in., and take platforms up to 96 x 156 in.
key_features: Reinforced heavy-plate platform and wide base
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Spacesaver High-Rise Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: High-travel scissor lifts with up to 168 in. of travel on a small footprint, rated up to 12,000 lb.
lines.content:
Spacesaver High-Rise Lift Tables provide a lot of vertical travel while using little floor space. They serve as mezzanine and cargo lifts, in automated palletizing systems and in other high-reach applications.

Models carry from 1,000 to 12,000 lb, with vertical travel up to 168 in. and platforms up to 72 x 144 in. Footswitch or hand pendant controls are available.
key_features: Up to 168 in. of vertical travel
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Stainless Steel Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Stainless steel scissor lifts for washdown areas in food and pharmaceutical plants, rated 2,000 and 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
Southworth's stainless steel lift tables are built to the same standard as its LS-Series tables, for sanitary washdown areas in food and pharmaceutical production. Cylinders carry a USDA-approved corrosion-resistant finish.

Standard models are rated at 2,000 or 4,000 lb on a 42 x 48 in. platform and raise to 36 in. Custom stainless tables are also built.
categories: Lift Tables > Stainless Steel Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Pneumatic Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Air bag scissor lifts powered by shop air, rated 2,000 and 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
Southworth Pneumatic Lift Tables are raised by a heavy-duty air bag on shop air instead of hydraulics, so there is no fluid to leak into clean processes and less maintenance to do.

They lift 2,000 or 4,000 lb at 80 psi, raise to 32 in., and take platforms up to 48 x 48 in.
key_features: Air bag lift on shop air (80 psi, 15 cfm)

lines.title: Southworth Floor-Height Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Pan-style lift tables that lower to floor level for pallet truck loading, rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
Floor-Height Lift Tables have a low pan-style platform that lowers to floor level, so pallets can be rolled on and off with a hand pallet truck and the table can be reached from all four sides. A safety-yellow elastomeric front edge protects operators.

Models are rated at 2,000, 4,000 and 6,000 lb, with a 50 x 48 in. pan that lowers to under 1/2 in. and raises to about 35 in.
key_features: Lowers to floor level for pallet truck loading
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth LiftMat Low-Profile Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Low-profile lift tables that collapse to 3-1/4 in. with four-sided access, rated up to 2,200 lb.
lines.content:
The LiftMat collapses to 3-1/4 in., low enough to work without a pit, and can be loaded from all four sides. An optional ramp lets hand pallet trucks roll straight on, and a full-perimeter toe guard stops the table if it meets an obstruction on the way down.

It is rated for 2,200 lb and raises to 34-3/4 in., on 24 x 66 in. or 48 x 96 in. platforms, for evenly distributed loads. An integral turntable version is also offered.
categories: Lift Tables > Low Profile Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Flush-Mount Turntable Lifts
lines.excerpt: Scissor lifts with a built-in turntable that sits just 3/16 in. above the platform.
lines.content:
Flush-Mount Turntable Lifts build the turntable into the platform so it sits just 3/16 in. above the deck, adding rotation without the extra height of a turntable mounted on top. Bearings and supports sit under the platform.

Turntables come in 20 and 43 in. diameters. The standard models listed have a 48 x 48 in. platform with a 43 in. turntable. The 43 in. model can be pit-mounted with added toe protection, and a rotation lock engages automatically when the lift is fully lowered.

lines.title: Southworth Manual Dandy Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Foot-pump portable scissor lift carts rated 330 to 1,760 lb, with lift heights up to 49-3/4 in.
lines.content:
Dandy Lift carts are compact portable scissor lifts for lifting, positioning, assembling, stacking and moving materials, and they double as adjustable-height work surfaces. A manual foot pump raises the platform, so no power is needed.

Models range from 330 to 1,760 lb, with raised heights up to 49-3/4 in. Ergonomic handles have padded grips, and an integrated floor lock holds the cart in place.

lines.title: Southworth Powered Dandy Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Battery-powered portable lift carts rated 220 to 500 lb, with lift heights up to 51 in.
lines.content:
Powered Dandy Lift Tables raise and lower at the push of a button, with fully shielded electrical components, a battery status indicator and an onboard charger. They are compact and quiet enough for high-tech, retail and office settings as well as industrial ones.

Models are rated from 220 to 500 lb and raise to as much as 51 in., on smooth-rolling casters with an integrated floor lock.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Dandy Levelers
lines.excerpt: Spring self-leveling carts that keep tote boxes at a steady height, rated 330 and 1,100 lb.
lines.content:
The Dandy Leveler is a self-leveling cart for feeding parts in tote boxes. As material is added or removed, springs raise or lower the platform so the work stays at a level height with less bending and reaching.

Two models carry 330 and 1,100 lb. Load settings are changed by adjusting the springs, and the cart rolls on locking casters with padded push handles.

lines.title: Southworth Lift + Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Tables with independent lift and tilt control, in hydraulic and pneumatic versions rated 2,000 to 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
Southworth Lift + Tilt Tables control lift and tilt independently, so containers can be set at the right height and angle and adjusted as the center of gravity shifts. The tilt hydraulics retract inside the open-frame top for a lower profile when fully down.

Hydraulic (GLT) models run on 115V power and tilt 30 or 45 degrees. Their universal tilter base is shorter but wider, for stability in a small footprint. Pneumatic (GLTA) models tilt 30 degrees on shop air.
key_features: Tilt hydraulics retract inside the frame

lines.title: Southworth Low-Profile Lift + Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Floor-level lift and tilt tables with a 50 x 48 in. pan, rated 2,000 and 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
The Low-Profile Lift + Tilt combines a floor-height lift table and a tilter. Its 50 x 48 in. pan-style platform loads with a hand pallet truck and accepts any container, including those with reinforcing bars.

Lift and tilt are controlled independently: loads can be set at any height up to 33-1/2 in. and any angle up to 30 degrees. Models are rated at 2,000 or 4,000 lb.
key_features: Loads at floor level with a hand pallet truck
Up to 33-1/2 in. lift and 30 degrees tilt
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Fixed-Height Tilters
lines.excerpt: Hydraulic tilters for shallow containers, tilting 30 or 45 degrees and rated 1,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
Fixed-Height Tilters suit smaller or shallower containers that need tilting but not lifting. They sit directly on the floor or on a fixed-height base.

Hydraulic models are rated from 1,000 to 6,000 lb, tilt 30 or 45 degrees, and run on 115V power, with platforms up to 72 x 48 in.

lines.title: Southworth Pan-Style Container Tilters
lines.excerpt: Floor-level container tilters that tip loads up to 85 degrees, rated 2,000 and 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
Pan-Style Container Tilters have a low-profile 50 x 50 in. pan that loads with hand carts or pallet trucks and takes almost any container style, including those with reinforcing bars.

They tilt loads up to 85 degrees and are rated at 2,000 or 4,000 lb. A side-entry version is also available.
key_features: Loads with a hand pallet truck
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth E-Z Reach Portable Container Tilters
lines.excerpt: Battery-powered portable fork tilters that tip baskets up to 85 degrees, rated 2,000 and 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
E-Z Reach Portable Tilters roll between work stations on casters and tilt baskets up to 85 degrees, so workers can reach the contents without bending.

Models carry 2,000 or 4,000 lb and run on 12V DC power with a built-in charger, with AC power available. Standard models suit open-bottom containers and straddle models suit closed-bottom containers.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Roll-On Container Tilters
lines.excerpt: Container tilters with fork channels for pallet truck loading, tilting up to 85 degrees at 2,000 and 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
Roll-On Container Tilters have integrated fork channels so containers can be set on them directly with a hand pallet truck or fork truck. They handle wire baskets, plastic containers and gaylords.

They tilt loads up to 85 degrees, are rated at 2,000 or 4,000 lb, and are available with footswitch or hand pendant control.
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth PalletPal 360 Level Loaders
lines.excerpt: Self-leveling pallet positioners with a 360 degree turntable, in spring, air and stainless steel versions for 400 to 4,500 lb loads.
lines.content:
PalletPal 360 level loaders keep the top of a pallet load at a comfortable height, rising automatically as items come off and lowering as they go on. A turntable top gives full 360 degree access, and all components sit inside the turntable ring, so there is no reach-over zone.

The spring model uses springs and shock absorbers and needs no power or air. The Air model uses a reinforced air bag, with a spring to support the turntable if air is lost. The stainless steel model is the spring design built for corrosive environments. All handle loads from 400 to 4,500 lb, have fork pockets, and can take optional leveling feet.
key_features: Spring, air bag and stainless steel versions
categories: Lift Tables > Stainless Steel Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Powered PalletPal Levelers
lines.excerpt: Operator-controlled pallet positioners with a turntable top, in hydraulic and pneumatic versions rated 2,000 and 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
Powered PalletPal Levelers let the operator set the pallet height with a foot control rather than relying on springs, which suits loads that vary widely in weight, size or pallet type. A bearing-supported turntable rotates 360 degrees so work is always done from the near side.

Hydraulic models run on 115V power and pneumatic models on shop air at 80 psi and 15 cfm. Both come in 2,000 and 4,000 lb capacities, on a wide stable base with fork pockets.

lines.title: Southworth PalletPal Roll-In Level Loaders
lines.excerpt: Pallet positioners loaded by rolling a pallet truck in, rated 2,200 lb with a 3-1/4 in. lowered height.
lines.content:
The PalletPal Roll-In is loaded by driving a hand pallet truck into it with the pallet raised, then lowering the truck to set the pallet on the platform and rolling out. It works with any open-bottom pallet or skid.

It is rated for 2,200 lb, lowers to 3-1/4 in. and raises to 34-3/4 in. A footswitch gives hands-free positioning, and a full-perimeter toe guard adds safety.
key_features: Loads with a hand pallet truck
Lowers to 3-1/4 in., raises to 34-3/4 in.
categories: Lift Tables > Low Profile Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth PalletPal Roll-On Level Loaders
lines.excerpt: Floor-level pallet positioners loaded with a pallet truck, rated 2,500 and 4,000 lb, with a turntable version.
lines.content:
PalletPal Roll-On Level Loaders lower to floor height so pallets can be rolled on and off with a hand pallet truck. Internal hydraulic power, with pushbutton or footswitch control, keeps the load at the best height, and narrow side and back panels let workers reach it from four sides.

The standard loader is rated at 2,500 or 4,000 lb, with a photo-eye that stops descent if the beam is broken. The Roll-On Leveler with Turntable adds a 360 degree turntable and toe protection on three sides, at 2,500 lb.
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Mast Lift 26
lines.excerpt: A fast electro-hydraulic mast lift that raises pallet loads from 1/2 in. to 36-1/2 in. in about seven seconds, rated 1,800 lb.
lines.content:
The Mast Lift 26 raises a low-profile platform on a single mast, so pallets can be loaded with a pallet jack and unloaded from three sides at an ergonomic height. Its sealed cartridge-style electro-hydraulic actuator travels in about seven seconds, up to three times faster than traditional hydraulic lifts, with no hydraulic maintenance.

It is rated for 1,800 lb on a 44 x 56 in. platform. Safety scanners stop the platform within 200 ms if they detect a person or obstruction, and all moving parts are enclosed in the mast. The unit is pre-wired, runs on 230V single-phase power and can be moved with a pallet jack.
key_features: Lowers to 1/2 in., raises to 36-1/2 in.
Safety scanners stop the platform within 200 ms
Sealed actuator with no hydraulic maintenance
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Southworth Stackbox Positioners
lines.excerpt: Mast-style positioners for totes and junior containers, rated 1,000 lb with a 28-1/2 in. lift.
lines.content:
Stackbox Positioners raise small containers such as totes and junior containers on a vertical mast rather than a scissor, using little floor space. Containers are rolled onto the forks or solid pan with a dolly or hand cart.

They are rated for 1,000 lb and lift to 28-1/2 in. from a 2-1/2 in. lowered height, with fork-style or platform-style carriages and pushbutton or footswitch control.
